prompt: Who set the Guinness World Record by building the largest Nerf gun, measuring 3.81 meters (12 feet 6 inches), on October 15, 2021?
answer: Michael Pick, an American engineer and YouTuber from Huntsville, Alabama, set the Guinness World Record for building the largest Nerf gun. It measured 3.81 meters (12 feet 6 inches) and was based on the Nerf N-Strike Elite Longshot CS-6.
